data.name: Firdosh
data.gender_notes: Firdosh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Firdosh is a powerful and victorious name, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vardhana' which means 'to grow, expand, or increase'. It is a name of strength, signifying the conqueror within. It is believed that those named Firdosh are blessed with the courage to overcome adversity and the loyalty to keep their promises. The name Firdosh carries the meaning “Powerful, Victorious, Conqueror” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Firdosh usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, victorious, conqueror and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Firdosh is a name of the deity Vishnu, signifying his power to protect and sustain the universe. It is a name that invokes the qualities of courage, loyalty, and strength. It is a name that brings blessings of prosperity, abundance, and protection.
data.etymology: Firdosh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, Victorious, Conqueror.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Firdosh total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
